meta.name: Pilot base - 100 albums
notes: Editorial selection compiled from the author's own knowledge; not an objective ranking.
barcode and musicbrainz_id are intentionally null: to be resolved automatically by the app.
typical_availability is an editorial guess, not checked against any shop's stock.
confidence = confidence in year/label/title details; 'medium' entries should be checked first.
Classical music is deliberately excluded from this pilot.
